offering_description.value: Amdocs sells software that helps communications and media providers manage customers, bill for services and operate networks. It develops and licenses the software and helps customers integrate, migrate and run these systems on premises or in the cloud.

primary_products.value: Billing and charging software; customer care and order management software; service and network orchestration software; network inventory and assurance software; digital subscription management software

primary_services.value: Managed IT operations; software implementation and systems integration; cloud migration and modernization; technology consulting; software testing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Mobile and fixed-line telecom operators, cable and broadband providers, and media and streaming companies

end_markets.value: Telecommunications; cable and broadband; media and entertainment; video streaming

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Multi-year outsourced IT operations and large software implementation and modernization projects; licensing or royalties: Rights to deploy billing, customer management and network operations software; subscription: Recurring access to cloud-hosted software and digital subscription platforms; service fees: Consulting, integration, migration and testing engagements
revenue_model.category: project or contract; licensing or royalties; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Develops billing, customer management and network operations platforms for communications and media providers; service provider: Integrates and operates customer IT systems for communications and media providers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Telecom billing, customer management, network operations, digital subscriptions, and managed IT and integration services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise account teams selling to telecom operators and media providers; partners / resellers: Cloud infrastructure partners that jointly market and deliver telecom software and modernization projects

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Subscriber data processing and cross-border transfers subject to GDPR and other applicable privacy laws

notes: The current scope of Amdocs’ standalone media content distribution operations is uncertain.
